text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy,
Kawakami
Princess and I decide to go
watch a movie.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! We got the very last
piece of
bonus merch!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard they didn't have many left, so I
was
feeling really on edge!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Totally! I love Princess Fighter too much
to miss
the chance at getting this merch!
choice_data_list: Glad you managed to get it!
Glad you were able to get it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Biko! What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kawakami! Did you two come to see Princess Fighter vs. Carrot Ranger too?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There was no way I'd miss this
dream
matchup between princess and
hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I don't think any fan
would!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Only problem is... they ran out of the
bonus
merch. I was really looking
forward to getting
one...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my! In that case, you can have mine.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure that's okay?! You really
wanted
one too, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem at all. It's only natural for
a
princess to look out for the younger
students!
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Thanks so much, Kawakami! I'll
treasure
this forever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, no movie viewing is complete
without
popcorn! ♪
Excuse me, I'd like
the glazed-carrot flavor,
please!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice! The Carrot Ranger Special! I'll
have
one too, please!

text_block_list.name: Kiosk Attendant
text_block_list.text:
I'm very sorry, but we only have one
bucket of
glazed-carrot flavor left.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But glazed carrot is Carrot
Ranger's
favorite!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No need to fret! Why don't we share a
bucket? ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really?! Thanks so much,
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, there's no need to praise me.
Such
conduct is only natural for a
princess!
choice_data_list: Look at you, being such a great senpai!
Look at you, being such a great senpai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the movie finishes, we make our
way home.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: WAAAAH! That! Was! AMAAAZIIING!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Princess Fighter is the absolute
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
S-stop crying! What if your eyeballs fall
out?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But... but... it was so emotionally moving!
Seeing
Princess Fighter on that massive
screen! It was so
dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sob... I won't forget this day for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should we do, Trainer?! It
doesn't look
like Kawakami can stop!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should we do, Trainer?! It
doesn't look
like Kawakami can stop!
choice_data_list: Tears don't suit a princess, you know!
Let's let her cry as much as she needs to.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! A real hero overcomes
their tears
and presses onward!
choice_data_list: Tears don't suit a princess, you know!
Let's let her cry as much as she needs to.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hic! H... huh?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, but how am I supposed to suppress all these feelings?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm so overcome with emotions, I feel
like I could
tear apart anything I lay my
hands on!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan! I'll even run with you!
choice_data_list: If you want to let off steam, nothing beats a good run!
If you want to let off steam, nothing beats a good run!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, the evening sun is so beautiful.
This is no
doubt the kind of scenery
Princess Fighter wanted
to protect.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! And Carrot Ranger was
fighting right
alongside her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running vigorously for a while, the
two seem
to have entered a state of
mental bliss. Their
passionate friendship
deepens even further!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hic... Thank you! BWAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hic... Hic...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Siiiigh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Have you calmed down, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel so refreshed! It's just like they
say in
Princess Fighter: "Tears are the
sweat of the
heart—the more you shed,
the stronger you
become!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right! I've just taken another step on the path to becoming the mightiest princess!
choice_data_list: Then that's made you even stronger!
Then that's made you even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You two seem just like the real
Princess
Fighter and Legendary Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, please don't say anything to make
me
happier! I could end up kicking this
bench and
splitting it in two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess looks liable to burst
at any
moment, so I frantically try to
calm her down
before any damage is
done.
